name: Tatsuhara Souya
source:
Year: 2nd Year
Favorite Subject: Music
Hobby: Surfing
Food that he isn’t good with: Natto
Favorite Words: No music, No life!

The heroine’s classmate. His behavior in school is always vigorous and intuitive, his positiveness is strong. Loving surfing because it’s active, he receives high popularity from many females because of his character. Has been a rival of his classmate [url=/c6091]Kyousuke[/url] probably because he is slightly a narcissist. Though he isn’t good at studying, and though his wild music is stupid, his popularity with the senpais and kouhais recommend him to be the next student council president due to his popularity. His nickname is [Tattsun].
